Choose one willing ally within 4 squares that can perceive your signal and is adjacent to an enemy. The ally makes one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy. On a Strong result, the ally may also push the target 1. This requires a melee weapon and the ability to attack. This is a single free Basic Melee attack.
